description: This file defines an interface class 'ISessionManagementServer' for session management in an IPC (Inter-Process Communication) context within the Rialto server component. It declares virtual methods for initializing, starting, stopping, and setting log levels for the session management server.

classes.name: ISessionManagementServer
classes.description: An interface class for session management server operations in the Rialto IPC module.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the session management server with a socket name and permissions.

methods.name: setLogLevels
methods.description: Sets the log levels for default, client, IPC, and common logs.
